title: Eulerian Video Magnification
summary: The video accompanying the SIGGRAPH 2012 paper on Eulerian Video Magnification. It amplifies subtle changes in ordinary video, such as skin color shifts from a heartbeat, to reveal pulse and tiny motions.
why: Cited as the canonical demonstration of pulling out invisible signals like pulse from video, with commenters imagining other applications.

quote.text: they amplified color changes. So the tiny flushes caused by the heartbeat were clearly visible
